analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단 이후 RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 현재 53.9 수준에서 중립 구간 횡보 중. ADX는 14.0으로 추세 형성 미약. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환 확정 신호는 미흡. 5일 연속 변동률은 +3.06%로 상승 마감했으나, 20일 고가 123,110원 저항선 하단에 위치. 52주 위치 38.8%로 여전히 낮은 수준. 변동성(ATR 9.00%) 고려 시, 명확한 방향성 부재로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy signal, RSI has exited oversold territory but is currently consolidating in the neutral zone at 53.9. ADX is weak at 14.0, indicating no clear trend formation. MACD histogram shows improvement but lacks confirmation of a trend reversal. Despite a +3.06% gain on the latest day, the price remains below the 5-day high of 123,110, which acts as resistance. The 52-week position at 38.8% remains low. Considering the volatility (ATR 9.00%), a wait-and-see approach is maintained due to the absence of a clear directional signal.

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 해석: 명확한 고점/저점 형성 부재

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 115,580) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 108,586 / 107,021 / 117,401): Short/mid-term trend position diagnosis: Above SMA5, SMA20; below SMA50.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (KRW 142,339 / 104,627): Mid/long-term trend strength assessment: Below SMA100; above SMA200.
· 52-week position (38.8%) + Historical context of current price range: Higher than 52-week low, but significantly lower than the high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.7→53.9) + exiting oversold + maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1821.8685→2340.4762) + improving + potential for trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 107,021) + Bandwidth at 19.42% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 68,045) + Rationale: Pivot S1 (KRW 98,917) acting as short-term support.
· Swing Resistance (KRW 123,110) + Implication of breakout: Aligns with 5-day high and upper Bollinger Band.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) + Trend interpretation: Absence of clear higher highs or higher lows.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.86x) + Assessment of movement conviction: Below average volume indicates weak conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) + Entry/wait-and-see conditions: Consider buying on a breakout above KRW 123,110; consider selling on a break below support at KRW 98,917.
